title: Marry My Husband
hook: How does Marry My Husband end? The redirected fate, Min-hwan killed by Su-min, and Ji-won's new life with Ji-hyuk, explained.

sections.heading: The second-chance premise
sections.body: Marry My Husband opens with Kang Ji-won, terminally ill and trapped in a miserable marriage, catching her husband Park Min-hwan in an affair with her supposed best friend, Jeong Su-min. During the confrontation Min-hwan accidentally kills her. The spirit of Ji-won's late father then sends her consciousness back to the year 2013 with all her memories intact, granting her a chance to rewrite her doomed life. Armed with foreknowledge of every betrayal to come, Ji-won sets out not merely to survive but to redirect her cruel fate onto the very people who engineered it, turning the timeline into a weapon of revenge.

sections.heading: Redirecting fate onto the betrayers
sections.body: Ji-won discovers she is not the only traveller. Her manager, Yoo Ji-hyuk, has also been sent back, having fallen in love with her in the previous timeline and knowing it was Min-hwan who caused her death. Together they engineer a quiet inversion of fate, steering Su-min into marrying Min-hwan in Ji-won's place so the misery she once endured is passed to the two people who deserve it. While she dismantles her old tormentors, Ji-won simultaneously builds a genuine relationship with Ji-hyuk, the timeline's mechanics letting her hand off her curse instead of breaking it.

sections.heading: How the villains fall
sections.body: The revenge pays off decisively. Park Min-hwan is killed by Su-min, the partnership the schemers entered into curdling into lethal violence, and Su-min is then arrested and incarcerated for the act. Yu-ra, who attempts to murder Ji-won, dies in a car accident once her plot is exposed. Even the transferred cancer, which lands on colleague Yang Ju-ran, is defused: Ju-ran catches it early and is treated, sparing both her and Ji-won from the disease that defined the first timeline. Every thread of the original tragedy is unwound and turned back on those who caused it.

sections.heading: Ji-won's happy ending
sections.body: The finale jumps to 12 April 2023, with Ji-won and Ji-hyuk attending an art exhibition together, the date marking how far they have travelled from the fate that once awaited them. Having sidestepped every misfortune of the previous timeline, the two marry, have children and are shown settling into a peaceful life. The series closes on unambiguous wish-fulfilment: the betrayers punished, the illness escaped, and the woman who was murdered in her first life now safe, loved and free. It is a clean, triumphant resolution to the second-chance fantasy the show set up.

final_image: Ji-won and Ji-hyuk stroll through an art exhibition on a spring day in 2023, the misfortunes of the old timeline behind them, on their way to marriage and a settled family life.

lingering_questions.q: What happens to Park Min-hwan and Jeong Su-min?
lingering_questions.a: Min-hwan is killed by Su-min after their schemes collapse, and Su-min is arrested and incarcerated for it. The fate Ji-won once suffered is redirected onto the two people who betrayed her in the original timeline.

lingering_questions.q: Who does Ji-won end up with?
lingering_questions.a: She ends up with Yoo Ji-hyuk, the manager who was also sent back in time and loved her in the previous life. After avoiding the old timeline's tragedies, they marry, have children and live peacefully together.
